value: Four post-training stages on top of SmolLM3-3B: LoRA supervised fine-tuning on a synthetic formal-logic corpus, checkpoint fusion (parameter-space averaging of intermediate SFT checkpoints), WiSE-FT interpolation toward the base with λ = 0.25, and MGPO (entropy-weighted GRPO reinforcement learning against a programmatic verifier), published checkpoint step 2071.
quote: Four stages on top of the base model: [...] 1. **LoRA supervised fine-tuning** on a synthetic formal-logic corpus covering the Track A [...] 2. **Checkpoint fusion** — parameter-space averaging of intermediate SFT checkpoints selected [...] 3. **WiSE-FT interpolation** toward the pretrained base, `W = (1 − λ)·W_base + λ·W_finetuned` [...] 4. **MGPO** — entropy-weighted GRPO reinforcement learning against a programmatic verifier, with [...] partial credit for loose matches and token-F1 so that all-fail prompt groups still produce
quotes: Four stages on top of the base model:
1. **LoRA supervised fine-tuning** on a synthetic formal-logic corpus covering the Track A
2. **Checkpoint fusion** — parameter-space averaging of intermediate SFT checkpoints selected
3. **WiSE-FT interpolation** toward the pretrained base, `W = (1 − λ)·W_base + λ·W_finetuned`
4. **MGPO** — entropy-weighted GRPO reinforcement learning against a programmatic verifier, with
partial credit for loose matches and token-F1 so that all-fail prompt groups still produce

value: WiSE-FT interpolation toward the base with λ = 0.25 (only a quarter of the fine-tuned delta retained), chosen by constrained optimisation (maximise in-domain score subject to minimal held-out degradation) so held-out capability survives. Checkpoint fusion averaged intermediate SFT checkpoints selected by a diversity probe rather than the final checkpoint. MGPO (entropy-weighted GRPO) used partial credit for loose matches and token-F1 so all-fail prompt groups still produce gradient. A sibling arm without the conservative interpolation scored higher in-domain but lost about twelve points of held-out capability; this release is the balanced point of that trade.

value: TwIL-LM3 Track A (in-domain): lean_formalize token_f1 0.5869; rule_induction derivation 0.3192; entailment_label accuracy 0.5750; semantic_parse token_f1 0.4416; lean_critic accuracy 0.6600; macro gate 0.4218; strict-7 0.1971. Track B (held-out): gsm8k 0.8733; svamp 0.8500; macro (10 CoT datasets) 0.7339; macro (all 14) 0.6694.

Track A (in-domain formal logic lanes): lean_formalize, rule_induction, entailment_label, mcq_answer, semantic_parse, lean_critic, plus lm_corpus and math_corpus perplexity. Track B (held-out benchmarks): gsm8k, svamp, gsm_symbolic, arc_cot, logicbench, strategyqa, drop, csqa, musr, mmlu_redux, ifeval, rudas_ood, bbh_logic, math500.

Track A: n = 200 per objective, greedy (temperature = 0), max_new_tokens = 2048, one retry at 4096 for truncated rows, max_seq_len = 8192, seed 42. Track B: 300 examples per task, greedy, max_gen_toks = 4096, max_model_len = 8192, repetition_penalty = 1.0, chat template applied, vLLM backend. Same protocol for model and base in a paired run over identical sampled rows.
